newsitem.title: USA: Cyanotech sees 'significantly lower' Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Cyanotech sees 'significantly lower' Q1 net.

text.p: Cyanotech Corp said Monday it expected significantly lower first-quarter net income and 20-25 percent lower revenues compared to the same quarter a year earlier due to weakened demand for its packaged consumer products for export.

"We expect to report first-quarter revenues that are 20 percent to 25 percent below the $2.5 million reported for the first quarter of fiscal 1997," said Ronald Scott, executive vice president and chief financial officer of the microalgae products company.

"Gross margin percentages for the first quarter are expected to approximate gross margin percentages for the year earlier first quarter, but net income and net income per share are expected to be significantly less than the $845,000 and $0.05 per share reported for the first quarter of fiscal 1997," Scott added.
Actual results for the first quarter are expected to be announced on July 17, 1997.
Cyanotech's first fiscal quarter of 1998 ends June 30, 1997.
